title: B2B Sales Account Executive (Education/Schools)
description:
Position name: Partnerships Manager

# K–12 #Education #B2B

*****************************************************************

* MUST HAVE experience in B2B consultative sales for schools*

*****************************************************************

******IMPORTANT******

Qualification: Mid-level 3+ years

English: Fluent

Contract: Contractor (PJ) – full-time

Compensation: Competitive fixed monthly amount + variable commission, aligned with experience.

Location: Hybrid, 3+ days on-site in São Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).

************************

About Us

WorldEd is an established K-12 school and education provider with an international footprint built through long-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions. We support partners with high-quality learning solutions and a delivery model designed for real implementation. As we grow, we’re strengthening our commercial operation with people who execute reliably, building partnerships that are commercially sound and operationally deliverable.

Job Overview

You’ll run end-to-end consultative B2B sales with schools and educational institutions, including outbound prospecting, discovery, proposal, negotiation, and contract signature. You’ll be responsible for closing deals that can be delivered—confirming feasibility and aligning with Academic, Growth, and Customer Success. This role is for someone who takes full ownership: builds pipeline proactively, resolves issues, and steps in when urgent partner or contract matters threaten signature, delivery, or retention.

Commercial Coverage (important): Occasionally, urgent partner or contract matters may arise outside standard working hours (including during breaks). When this happens, you are expected to be reachable, respond promptly, and help drive resolution, especially when a deal is at signature stage or a partner issue risks delivery or retention. This is occasional, not constant, but we take responsibility when something critical must be handled.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full-cycle consultative sales process with schools, school groups, and strategic partners—from prospecting to signed contract.
  • Prospect and qualify opportunities (outbound + inbound) aligned to the ICP and sales strategy.
  • Lead structured discovery to understand needs, constraints, stakeholders, and decision process.
  • Build tailored proposals that define scope, assumptions, success criteria, pricing, and timelines.
  • Negotiate and close within commercial policy; escalate exceptions when needed.
  • Manage pipeline, forecasting, and activity cadence with strong CRM hygiene.
  • Align deals with Academic, Product, and Customer Success to ensure feasibility and smooth implementation.
  • Share market insights to improve messaging, playbooks, collateral, and go-to-market decisions.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years in B2B consultative sales (preferably K–12, EdTech, services, or recurring revenue).
  • Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder, longer sales cycles and consistently hit targets.
  • Strong discovery, proposal, negotiation, and closing skills (including objection handling).
  • Highly organized: pipeline management, follow-up discipline, and accurate forecasting.
  • Clear, influential communication with both operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and good judgment around risks/feasibility.
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) with strong data hygiene.
  • Fluent English required; willing to travel.

This role is not for you if… (important)

  • ... you rely on heavy inbound only or avoid outbound prospecting.
  • ... you are comfortable closing deals without confirming delivery feasibility.
  • … you prefer to “hand off” problems instead of owning them through to resolution.
  • … you do only what is explicitly assigned and avoid going the extra mile.
  • … you expect strict boundaries regardless of context and won’t step in when something urgent needs to be resolved.

What We Offer

  • A culture in a constantly growing segment with continuous learning opportunities.
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd's American programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model: 3+ days on-site in São Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).
  • Parking space at our headquarters.
  • Competitive fixed monthly amount + variable commission, aligned with experience.

If you're passionate about helping students succeed through high-quality education, disciplined about pipeline management, strong in discovery and negotiation, and committed to selling deals that can be delivered well, we want to hear from you.

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application.   • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;

Highly Desirable Skills

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. #Vempraília

Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.
  • Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, PostgreSQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: CosmosDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e gRPC.
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
  • Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).
  • Proficiência em containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou ArgoCD.
  • Uso avançado de Git e estratégias colaborativas de ramificação (branching) (Gitflow, práticas de code review).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
  • Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
  • Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade comprovada de contribuir para refatoração de código, otimização de desempenho e melhorias arquiteturais contínuas.
  • Compreensão de conceitos de sistemas distribuídos e sua aplicação prática.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços complementares em Node.js.
  • Experiência com plataformas de investimento.
  • Experiência em ambiente financeiro.
  • Certificações em Nuvem (Cloud).

CARGO: Coordenador(a) Financeiro-Administrativo

LOCAL: São Paulo – Jaraguá

FORMATO: Presencial

SOBRE A EMPRESA

Empresa de médio porte com atuação em nível nacional, com cerca de 50 anos de atuação no mercado, especializada na fabricação de produtos e acessórios obtidos a partir do processamento do aço e atuando também como um dos principais Distribuidores em seu segmento.

Atua no desenvolvimento de soluções para ar-condicionado, ventilação e transporte de particulados, oferecendo uma linha completa de produtos fabricados em aço galvanizado, alumínio e inox, como coifas, dutos e acessórios. Reconhecida pelo rigoroso controle de qualidade, a empresa combina solidez, tradição e eficiência operacional, garantindo aos seus clientes economia, confiabilidade e agilidade nos prazos de entrega.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Responsável por coordenar e executar as rotinas administrativas, financeiras, contábeis, fiscais e de controladoria, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas financeiras, econômicas e contábeis da empresa. O(a) profissional atuará de forma próxima à Diretoria, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões estratégicas, melhoria de processos e sustentabilidade financeira do negócio.

  • Definir, revisar e implementar políticas e estratégias econômicas e financeiras alinhadas aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Revisar e aprimorar o planejamento financeiro e orçamentário;
  • Analisar e apresentar as demonstrações financeiras (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa);
  • Preparar relatórios financeiros e gerenciais periódicos para a Diretoria;
  • Gerenciar o capital de giro, garantindo equilíbrio entre liquidez e rentabilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos e ganho de eficiência operacional;

title: Analista de Suprimentos Pleno (Comprador Materiais)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Arauco

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Apoiar reuniões de potenciais clientes, demonstrações e provas de conceito (POC), com linguagem clínica e foco em desfechos, segurança e eficiência do serviço.

Participar de pitches e validações clínicas com decisores (médicos, enfermeiros, gestores).

Projetar, testar e versionar prompts e "kits de prompts" por caso de uso (triagem, educação do paciente, orientações, documentação, fluxos de atendimento).

Definir padrões de segurança: checklist de revisão clínica, red flags, critérios de escalonamento para humano e linguagem de orientação segura.

Monitorar qualidade das respostas (acurácia, aderência a protocolo, tom, completude), documentar falhas e propor ajustes de prompt e processo.

  • Experiência clínica mínima de 2 anos (hospital, ambulatório, teleatendimento, navegação de cuidado ou saúde digital).

  • Pensamento crítico para identificar riscos, priorizar problemas e melhorar processos.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Vivência com atendimento remoto, protocolos assistenciais e fluxos de serviço.

title: Tech Lead | Analytics & AI
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead de Analytics & AI para liderar tecnicamente um time multidisciplinar, atuando na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, machine learning e IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time, com protagonismo na definição de padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e boas práticas
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de desafios técnicos, removendo impedimentos e orientando decisões
  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala

LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em manutenção automotiva pesada, aplicada a caminhões canavieiros, tratores, transbordos e máquinas agrícolas.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

Our promise to you:

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry

What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.

We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Job description

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  2. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  3. Knowledge in Tax reform;
  4. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;

Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Supervisor (a) De Excelência Operacional - Qualidade
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Representação Institucional: Gestão de agendas com associações setoriais e manutenção da governança da área;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office e em ferramentas Google, incluindo GCP;

Profundo conhecimento das normas do BACEN (Res. 3.966, Circ. 3.978) e regulamentações de PLD/FT;

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI ou SQL);

Capacidade de estruturar Dashboards de performance e interpretar tendências de risco (Data Analytics);

Conhecimento em conta digital PF e PJ;

Experiência com gestão de pessoas;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.

About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)

Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

description:
Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Foco: Ventilação)
 
Excelente oportunidade para uma pessoa qualificada e com experiência na área de planejamento de mina, foco em ventilação.
 
A empresa
Nosso cliente é uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do mundo em atuação no país.
 
 A posição
Em um ambiente de mineração subterrânea onde a ventilação é o pilar fundamental da segurança e produtividade, você terá o desafio de conduzir o planejamento estratégico de sistemas de ventilação e refrigeração de minas subterrâneas. Essa posição exige expertise técnica para assegurar que a disciplina esteja em acordo com normas regulatórias e padrões internos. Trata-se de uma oportunidade única de planejar sistemas de ventilação de alta complexidade em minerações profundas. Suas decisões contribuirão diretamente em assegurar um ambiente de trabalho confortável e seguro para os times operacionais.
 
Responsabilidades
 
 Como especialista no tema, você será responsável por dimensionar e operacionalizar sistemas de ventilação que sustentem as operações de frentes de trabalho em acordo com o planejamento anual e estratégico de produção. Suas atribuições também incluem colaboração no design da mina, participação em projetos e comitês de emergência, execução de tarefas técnicas, com foco em resultados práticos e conformidade:
  • Simulação e Modelagem: Empregar softwares como Deswik, Ventsim para simulações termodinâmicas do fluxo de ar na mina, incluindo cenários de produção, dimensionamento de frota, geotermia bem como cenários de emergência. Validar os modelos com dados reais para assegurar a calibração do modelo.
  • Integração com Planos de Produção e Lavra: Analisar impactos básicos da ventilação em planos de lavra, desenvolvimento, sondagem e infraestrutura, colaborando com as diferentes áreas e assegurar resposta a variações operacionais. Ser o guardião dos padrões internos, assegurando equilíbrio entre segurança e metas de produção.
  • Conformidade com Normas Regulamentadoras: Garantir adesão às normas principais, como NR-22, ABNT NBR 16401, padrões internos da companhia, realizando revisões regulares e melhorias nos padrões.
  • Gestão de Perdas e Recirculações: Identificar perdas de ar através de inspeções em campo com instrumentos de medição, propor estratégias para reduzir recirculações, perdas. Interagir com as diversas disciplinas para construção do sequenciamento de atividades para melhorar a eficiência.
  • Melhoria de qualidade das instalações de ventilação: Desenvolver soluções com foco em melhores materiais, métodos ou tecnologias que assegurem a conformidade das vedações das estruturas que compõe o sistema de ventilação.
 
 Requisitos
É essencial que o profissional possua as seguintes habilidades e qualificações:
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia (Minas, Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil) com CREA ativo.
  • Especialização: Conhecimentos em aerodinâmica básica de minas, segurança subterrânea e princípios de sistemas de ar, com interesse em certificações em ventilação.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com softwares de planejamento de minas (ex.: Deswik, Datamine) e ventilação (ex.: Ventsim). Elaboração de apresentações executivas. Análise estatística de dados. Compreensão de normas técnicas nacionais.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 4 anos em mineração subterrânea, com pelo menos 2 anos em atividades relacionadas a ventilação de minas subterrâneas. Experiência em projetos de média escala, incluindo monitoramento e ajustes operacionais.

title: Cientista de Desenvolvimento de Produtos III
description:
Descrição das Atividades:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a comercialização de projetos de média a alta complexidade para desenvolver e comercializar inovações para produtos e processos novos e renovados, além de iniciativas de redução de custos;
  • Executar atividades de desenvolvimento de produtos e processos de média a alta complexidade, desde a concepção até a comercialização;
  • Identificar com precisão os requisitos do projeto, aplicando a capacidade de produção, os ingredientes, a formulação e o design adequados para atender às necessidades dos clientes, às especificações do produto e às metas financeiras;
  • Realizar avaliações sensoriais internas, aplicações de produtos e testes de validade para determinar a aceitabilidade de protótipos e produtos competitivos para clientes e consumidores;
  • Seguir as diretrizes e protocolos estabelecidos, abordagem científica e análise estatística no desenvolvimento de produtos, testes em fábricas, inicialização de fábricas, estudos sensoriais, estudos de estabilidade de validade, estudos de capacidade e desenvolvimento de especificações;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico para resolver problemas de média á alta complexidade relacionadas à produção e qualidade, identificando a causa raiz, desenvolvendo e implementando soluções, incluindo treinamento de pessoal de controle de qualidade/operações sobre as conclusões dentro da categoria de produto atribuída;
  • Apoiar um ambiente que promova a inovação, introduzindo continuamente ideias e conceitos de produtos para novos produtos, melhorias de qualidade e produtividade e facilitar a tomada de riscos calculados;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação da estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade ou redução de custos;
  • Desenvolver uma estratégia de matérias-primas em colaboração com o grupo da cadeia de abastecimento e fornecedores externos para obter um desempenho diferenciado dos novos produtos e qualidade;
  • Fornecer avaliações/perspectivas de risco técnico e comercial relacionadas com o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e atividades técnicas de gestão da marca;
  • Liderar, treinar e orientar técnicos;
  • Fornecer aconselhamento técnico a outros dentro da especialidade;

Experiências Anteriores:

  • Experiência comprovada na aplicação de normas técnicas, princípios, teorias, conceitos e interpretação de dados através de projetos experimentais sólidos e análises estatísticas (experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos e/ou processos alimentares, desde a concepção até a comercialização);
  • Sólido conhecimento em informática (Excel, Word, bancos de dados, software estatístico) e capacidade de criar planilhas, análises computacionais e relatórios;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de software relevantes (por exemplo, PLM, etc.). Capacidade de usar bancos de dados, software de apresentação e gerenciamento de projetos será um diferencial;

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Mestrado e/ou Doutorado em Ciência Alimentar, Química/Alimentar/Biológica ou áreas relacionadas;

Perfil Comportamental:

  • Foco em alcançar os objetivos do projeto e entregar resultados significativos;
  • Manter a responsabilidade pelos prazos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Adaptabilidade e resiliência: Confortável em lidar com ambiguidades, mudanças, prioridades e incertezas;
  • Lidar com riscos e desafios inesperados com serenidade e mentalidade voltada para a resolução de problemas;
  • Pensamento inovador: introduz continuamente novas ideias e conceitos para melhorias e inovação de produtos;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: trabalha de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Estabelecer relações sólidas com equipes internas e parceiros externos (fornecedores, instituições);
  • Comunicação e influência: comunica-se de forma clara e persuasiva em diferentes níveis da organização. Influencia decisões e alinha as partes interessadas em direção a objetivos comuns;
  • Liderança e orientação: Lidera e treina técnicos, fornecendo orientação e suporte técnico. Atua como um modelo de excelência técnica e comportamento profissional;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e pensamento analítico: Aplica projetos experimentais e análises estatísticas sólidas. Mantém a precisão na documentação, interpretação de dados e conformidade;
  • Orientação para o cliente e os negócios: Compreende as necessidades dos clientes e as traduz em soluções técnicas. Equilibra decisões técnicas com considerações financeiras e comerciais;

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação, pago inclusive nas férias;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Gympass/Wellhub;
  • Day Off Aniversário;
  • Horário de Trabalho: Segunda á Quinta de 08:00 ás 18:00 e Sexta das 08:00 ás 17:00 hrs;

description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja , Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital . Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala;1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente;23.000 pontos de distribuição;400.000 colaboradores; Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!

Posição: Analista de Dados Jr (Bilíngue)

Descrição da posição:

Realizar de forma abrangente o estabelecimento de sistemas centrais de monitorização de dados para todos os centros, incluindo modificações nos requisitos de extração do JMS e outras iniciativas de desenvolvimento de painéis de dados;

Gerar resultados de avaliação diários para métricas operacionais centrais em todos os centros, abrangendo indicadores relacionados com pontualidade, segurança e custos;

Fornecer apoio especializado a centros com desempenho insatisfatório, formulando planos de melhoria e garantindo a sua implementação;

Acompanhar anomalias significativas no cumprimento, tais como perdas ou reclamações de encomendas de alto valor e irregularidades em massa ao nível da plataforma.

Proficiente em vários softwares de escritório; familiaridade com sistemas de BI é uma vantagem. Superior completo em preferencialmente em Matemática ou Gestão Logística.

title: Full-Stack AI Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.

Responsibilities:

Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development

Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders

Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: , Redux, Mui, -query, -table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)

title: Clinical Market Expert - Ultrasound
description:
Job Title: Clinical Market Expert - Ultrasound

Company: CHISON

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

About Us:

CHISON is a global medical device company dedicated to innovation in ultrasound imaging . With a presence in over 100 countries, we are committed to improving medical care through cutting-edge ultrasound technology . Our values of Innovation, High-Quality, Passion, and Integrity drive our mission to make everyone healthier. Our vision is to become the leader in specialized ultrasound .

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Clinical Market Expert specializing in Ultrasound to be the key clinical and technical authority for CHISON in the Brazilian market. You will be the pivotal link between our ultrasound technology and the clinical community, driving market growth by leveraging deep ultrasound application expertise to shape marketing strategy, enable the sales team, and build lasting relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). This role requires hands-on clinical experience with ultrasound systems.

Core Responsibilities:

  1. Provide ultrasound-specific clinical and technical expertise during the sales cycle, demonstrating the full range of CHISON ultrasound systems , their capabilities, benefits, and potential clinical applications to customers.
  2. Develop and deliver high-level product training and education on ultrasound equipment operation and clinical best practices to customers and distributors.
  3. Create and validate compelling clinical marketing content (e.g., case studies, application notes, whitepapers) that showcases the clinical advantages of CHISON ultrasound solutions in areas such as General Imaging, Vascular, and OB/GYN.
  4. Support the development and execution of the regional ultrasound product marketing strategy and plan, working closely with the sales manager to achieve key performance indicators.
  5. Lead Key Opinion Leader (KOL) development and management within the ultrasound community in Brazil.
  6. Organize and support marketing activities, including webinars, seminars, workshops, and major trade shows/conferences, by performing advanced ultrasound product demonstrations .
  7. Monitor customer installations and provide post-sale clinical support to ensure high customer satisfaction and foster long-term relationships.
  8. Collaborate closely with the global marketing and R&D teams to relay market feedback and identify new ultrasound business opportunities .

Skills & Qualifications:

Mandatory Requirements:

  1. Clinical Ultrasound Experience: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience performing diagnostic ultrasound examinations in a clinical setting (e.g., hospital, imaging center). Proficiency in General Imaging/Abdominal and Vascular Sonography is required.
  2. Industry Background: Proven experience working directly with ultrasound devices . Previous roles in a clinical application specialist, sonographer, or similar capacity within an ultrasound equipment manufacturer are highly preferred.
  3. Language & Location: Full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English . Must be based in or willing to relocate to São Paulo State, Brazil .

Preferred Skills & Attributes:

  1. Marketing/Business Acumen: Prior experience in a commercial, marketing, or clinical support role within the medical device industry, specifically ultrasound .
  2. Technical & Soft Skills: Creative thinker, excellent presenter, problem-solver, and a self-motivated team player with strong interpersonal skills.
  3. Additional Clinical Knowledge: Experience in Cardiac or OB/GYN ultrasound is a significant advantage.

title: Avionics Engineer B2 (Riyadh Based)
description:
This role will be located at our Hub in Riyadh. A full and comprehensive relocation package will be offered.

About the Company

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role

Are you wired for success and passionate about advanced aircraft systems? Are you ready to take your career to a new altitude? We're seeking an experienced hands-on professional to join our Engineering and Maintenance team.

Your responsibility will be to perform maintenance, repairs, and inspections of our Boeing 787 fleet, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards. Additionally, typical duties include carrying out scheduled and unscheduled aircraft, engine, component maintenance and repairs compliant to the approved manufacturers documentation whilst observing all company safety procedures.

With a natural ability to lead in a time-critical environment, you will supervise teams undertaking Line Maintenance to optimise aircraft downtime. Key to this role is the inspection and certification of scheduled maintenance tasks, defect rectification, modifications, and functional tests on Airframe, Engine and Electrical systems.

Your days will be spent troubleshooting to keep our aircraft’s brains (avionics systems) in tip-top shape.

About You

A minimum Diploma/Certificate qualification and you will possess at least 8 years in Line Maintenance. Importantly, your maintenance experience includes the last 2 years certifying Boeing 787.

Boeing 787 Type Rating Level 3. You are also required to possess a valid GACA / EASA or other CAA B2 AV Aircraft Maintenance License.

The following mandatory documents are required and must be uploaded as part of your application:

  • Valid GACA / EASA or other CAA valid B2 AV Aircraft Maintenance License
  • Boeing 787 Aircraft Type training Level III original (practical and theoretical)
  • Last five (5) years aircraft maintenance experience records (logbook) stamped and signed by MRO/Operator Quality Assurance department.
  • Recency Letter from current (and previous employers if applicable) outlining scope of work and work duration, stamped and signed by Maintenance Repair Organisations (MRO) Quality Assurance Department
  • Current and previous Operator / MRO Certification Authorisation copy

You are also required to hold the appropriate police security clearance required for the role.

This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

We are looking for a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual must be highly comfortable working with pure code without relying on frameworks , especially in areas where the company prefers clean, raw implementations. The ideal candidate should have strong foundational skills in vanilla JavaScript , pure PHP , and writing code from scratch without the support of abstractions or libraries.

You will work across both the front-end and back-end of modern web applications using PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React , collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient and maintainable systems. Strong English communication skills are essential for interacting with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams.

What You Will Do:

The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP in pure form , avoiding unnecessary frameworks when required.
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using vanilla JavaScript , along with React when applicable.
  • Develop and optimize databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code without depending heavily on frameworks, ensuring clarity and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and long-term stability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to decisions involving raw code structure, system design, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure the product is performant, reliable, and aligned with business goals.
  • Stay updated with evolving best practices in no-framework development , JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and full stack engineering.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, especially in understanding code fundamentals and building solutions without relying on frameworks.
  • Prepare and maintain clear and detailed technical documentation.

What You Will Bring:

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested pure code in both PHP and JavaScript (examples may be requested).
  • Strong knowledge of vanilla JavaScript , DOM manipulation, event handling, and building functionality without libraries.
  • Expertise in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL , with hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or modern front-end frameworks, while still having the ability to work without them when needed.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in agile, team-based environments.
  • Knowledge of the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a passion for writing beautiful code.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, globally distributed environment.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development.
  • Hands-on experience with pure PHP , vanilla JavaScript , MySQL , PostgreSQL , SQL , and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to build solutions from scratch without relying on frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading complex projects from concept to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC principles and agile methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

title: Founder / Implementation Partner - Brazil
description:
About Lua

Lua is a YC-backed enterprise work management platform that's changing how organisations run. We replace the patchwork of spreadsheets, project tools, and disconnected systems that most companies use to manage their operations, with a single, unified AI platform that connects strategy to execution.

Our clients include some of the world's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, and professional services. They choose Lua because it gives them visibility they've never had before, the ability to see exactly what's happening across their organisation, in real time, and to make decisions based on reality rather than guesswork.

The product sells. Enterprises are actively looking for solutions like Lua, and when they see it, they get it. Your job is to find them, show them what's possible, and deliver implementations that transform how they work.

Learn more at our website,  

The Opportunity

We're looking for entrepreneurs to build and own exclusive Lua implementation agencies in markets around the world. This isn't a job, it's a funded business opportunity. You'll own 100% of your agency, keep the profits, and have exclusive rights to your territory.

We provide the startup capital, the product, and the training. You provide the ambition, the local expertise, and the execution. If you've ever wanted to run your own business but lacked the capital or the product to sell, this is it.

What You'll Do

Build your business. 

You'll start from zero and build a Lua implementation practice in Brazil. That means finding clients, closing deals, hiring a team, and delivering implementations that make clients successful.

Own the market. 

You'll have exclusive rights to Brazil. No other Lua agency will compete with you. Every Lua deal in your market is yours to win.

Deliver results. 

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.

Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.

What You'll Get

Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs

Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition

Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support

100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties

Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region

What We're Looking For

Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:

Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.

Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.

Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.

Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.

Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.

Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.

The Deal

We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.

If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.

If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

title: Product Owner SR
description:

We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;

title: Regional Sales Executive[Portuguese]
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Job Description

We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management: Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil.
  • Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Affiliate Onboarding: Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance.
  • Market Insights & Strategy: Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies.
  • Sales & Affiliate Reporting: Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts.
  • Administrative & Organizational Support: Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports.
  • Event Coordination: Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied.
  • Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Técnico (a) de Controle de Qualidade JR
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar análise de contra prova para a expedição de produtos e/ou envio de certificados de análise para clientes;
  • Efetuar diversas aferições e calibrações em equipamentos e vidrarias, e controlar estoque e solicitar a devida reposição ou abastecimento;
  • Analisar os produtos químicos, insumos e matéria prima direcionados para o processo produtivo, por médio da análise dos laudos, amostragem e análise do produto para cumprimento dos parâmetros especificados;
  • Receber produtos químicos, realizar testes e emitir relatório técnico para o controle de produtos químicos controlados e fiscalizados diretamente pela Policia Federal ou Forças Armadas Brasileira;
  • Acompanhar a classificação, reembalagem, transferências de armazéns e regularizações dos produtos painéis oriundos de devoluções de clientes;
  • Realizar inspeção visual, auditorias, análises e ensaios físicos-mecânicos e químicos em matéria prima, insumos, produtos em produção e de produtos acabados em observação e de reclamações de clientes bem como, identificar e preparar corpos de provas e amostras de materiais por meio da verificação dos laudos, amostragem e análise do produto.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em qualidade, química ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência de 6 meses em processos de produção;
  • Pacote Office Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas da Qualidade;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos de revezamento;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti
